name: English-to-Swedish Translationese Preferences Dataset
description: A dataset contrasting translationese sentences with idiomatic alternatives in English-to-Swedish translation, designed to probe language models' intrinsic preferences and biases toward literal versus natural translations. It includes error tags and descriptions to facilitate evaluation of models' ability to produce idiomatic output.
reputation: A niche research dataset for probing translationese preferences in English-to-Swedish translation, with limited community adoption so far.
notes: First freely available dataset for probing translationese preferences; includes error annotations and is useful for developing models producing idiomatic translations.
